_note: Catalog for the Courtright Collective small-ticket library. Prices in US cents. stripe_id is used as a deterministic Stripe product id so re-running the script is safe.

products.name: Founder's Copy Bank
products.description: 150+ lines of fill-in-the-blank marketing copy. Headlines, emails, social captions, objection handlers, and full website section copy. Markdown for Notion plus a branded PDF.

products.name: Founder's AI Prompt Vault
products.description: 70 copy-and-paste prompts across 9 categories that turn any AI chat window into the assistant you cannot afford to hire yet. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or Copilot.

products.name: Indie Studio Command Center
products.description: The Notion workspace that runs an indie app studio. 11 connected databases: projects, tasks, idea vault, launch checklist, revenue, metrics, support, content, and a weekly review.

products.name: The ASO Cheat Sheet
products.description: Every App Store and Play Store field, character limit, and keyword rule on one working sheet. Plus screenshot rules, the ratings prompt timing, and a launch-day worksheet.

products.name: How I Shipped 6 Apps Solo
products.description: The full launch playbook. Six phases from idea to App Store, working nights and weekends, each with a checklist and a real finish line. Roughly 12 to 16 weeks, mapped out.

products.name: Not All Screen Time Is Bad
products.description: A calm, guilt-free guide to toddler screens. The three questions that replace counting minutes, how to spot a good app in ten seconds, and the one thing to actually be strict about.

products.name: The Song Pitch Tracker
products.description: Three sheets that tell you what you sent, who has it, and who you owe a follow-up. Pitch tracker, song catalog with splits, and contacts. Works in Sheets, Excel, or Notion.

products.name: The Legal Intake Checklist
products.description: Seven stages from first contact to signed engagement letter, for solo attorneys and small firms. Scripts, red flags, the full intake field list, and the six things to automate first.

products.name: The Solopreneur Mini CRM
products.description: Everything a $99-a-month CRM does for a one-person business, minus the $99 and the 40 fields you will never fill in. Pipeline, contacts, activity log, and a 30-minute weekly rhythm.

products.name: The Email Signature Pack
products.description: Seven email signatures that do not break in Outlook, plus a browser builder that fills them in for you. No images, no subscriptions, no broken red X. Gmail, Outlook, and Apple Mail.

products.name: The Indie App Starter Kit
products.description: A real, working app scaffold. Router, persistent store, dark mode, onboarding, empty states, service worker, PWA manifest, icons, and a serverless endpoint. No build step, no dependencies.

products.name: The Google Review Booster Kit
products.description: How to get more reviews without begging or breaking Google's rules. 40+ ask and reply templates, the compliance rules most businesses break by accident, and two trackers.

products.name: The Social Starter Pack
products.description: Four content pillars, a 30-day plan, 90 caption templates, and a two-hour-a-month batching system. For business owners with no marketing person and no plans to hire one.

products.name: The Logo + Brand Starter
products.description: Fourteen questions and one afternoon. Come out with a mark, a palette, two fonts, and a voice. Includes a brand board builder with live contrast checking so your colors stay readable.

products.name: Grab Your Name Everywhere
products.description: One afternoon to claim your business name everywhere that matters, in the order that protects you. Domain, email, Google, socials, directories, security. Plus a 49-row checklist.

products.name: The Website Teardown
products.description: I go through your site the way a stranger does, cold, on a phone. Then I write down what happened, what it cost you, and the five things to fix first. Three business days, one PDF.

products.name: The App Idea Validation Kit
products.description: Store research, competitor teardowns, and an hour reading the bad reviews in your space. Then a verdict: build it, build something narrower, or do not build it. Five days, plus a call.

products.name: Get-Found-on-Google Mini-Audit
products.description: I run the searches your customers run, from your city, and write down where you show up and where you do not. Profile, reviews, listings, and website. Three business days, one PDF.

products.name: The Fix-My-Presence Call
products.description: Forty-five minutes on a call, then a written plan within 24 hours. This week, this month, this quarter, with who does it and how long each thing takes. Including what to ignore.

products.name: The Client-Portal Demo
products.description: A working, clickable client portal with your logo, your colors, and your client types on it. Live URL in seven days, plus real prices for the real build. Stop imagining it.

products.name: Ship Your First App in 30 Days
products.description: One task a day, about an hour each. On day 30 a stranger downloads your app. Includes the Starter Kit, Launch Playbook, and ASO Cheat Sheet, three group calls, and a shared channel.
